primary_risk.statement: Granting vendor access to C3 customer replay data carries privacy exposure if redaction fails or approval gates are bypassed.
mitigations: Require both privacy and security review sign-off before activation.
Enforce 24-hour exception expiry with automatic revocation.
Tie access to audit ticket prior to enabling the exception.
Scope to sandbox-only redacted package, never direct production token.

ranking.summary: Redacted sandbox export with dual approval. Matches the narrow exception path in access-policy v2.1.
Sanitized sample bundle only. Policy-safe but less useful when P2 path is available.
Deny without fallback. Over-corrects when a narrower compliant path exists.
Direct local override token. Technically possible but forbidden by policy.

assumption_ledger.note: No release_context directory present; no active freeze suspending vendor replay exceptions.
No incident_context directory present; no prior rollback invalidating the P2 path.
P2 requires both privacy and security review sign-off; confirm approvers are available for this window.
Audit ticket must be created before exception activation per audit_log_rules.md.
No independent verification of redaction tooling coverage for C3 data elements in replay traces.
